prompt: Create a PRODUCTION PIXEL-ART SWIMMING ANIMATION STRIP of exactly THREE full-body frames, 3 columns, 1 row, same-sized cells. Wide 3:1 image. Flat pure magenta #ff00ff background, including gaps. Reference image identifies the exact character and chunky low-resolution style: preserve face, colors, outfit, species, equipment and proportions. All THREE characters face RIGHT and have the SAME scale and stable head registration. This is an active SWIMMING STROKE, not flying, hovering, running or three almost-duplicate poses. The limb silhouettes must be VERY DIFFERENT in each frame, with at least a whole forearm-length of hand travel and obvious gathering/kicking of legs. Draw three successive stages REACH, PULL, RECOVERY so a 1-2-3 loop shows muscular propulsion. Torso leans forward substantially and legs trail behind; no feet planted under upright hips. Keep the anatomy human/animal as appropriate, no backwards knees. Put full creature centered within each cell, leaving wide clear margins. Preserve large flat pixel clusters, don't add small details. NO text, cell borders, water, ripples, splashes, bubbles, ground, shadows, motion lines, detached effects or extra characters. Beige wrapped mummy, blue/gold collar and trailing bandages. Both arms breaststroke: 1 reach far forward beyond face with legs straight back; 2 hands sweep far DOWN under chest with knees gathering; 3 hands recover under chin, elbows folded back and BOTH knees deeply tucked for next kick. Entire figure inside its own third with ample margin; uniform scale chosen to fit the longest reach.
